description: Canonical puzzle/solution catalog plus solver retrieval, replay-backed fragment flow and chemistry-aware composition planning for Opus Magnum Codex.

identity.canonicalStructuralHash: translation/rotation invariant hash preserving program timing
identity.canonicalMechanismHash: translation/rotation invariant hash with normalized program timing
identity.puzzleFeatureFingerprint: hash of solver-relevant puzzle chemistry, molecule topology, available parts and production constraints

fragmentFlowIndex.purpose: Catalog replay-observed composition transitions between canonical functional fragment mechanisms.
fragmentFlowIndex.lineage: Atom ids persist across replay molecule merge/split operations and are used as lineage markers.

compositionPrior.purpose: Rank historically observed fragment chains as solver composition priors.

chemistryAwareComposition.purpose: Join a target puzzle manufacturing plan to empirical fragment chains and retain candidates that cover the required functional transformations.

coverage.matched: required relation occurrences observed in the candidate chain
coverage.missing: required relation occurrences absent from the candidate chain

assemblyCompleteness.requiresConvergence: true when the manufacturing plan has more than one source operation
assemblyCompleteness.linearChainPolicy: A linear fragment chain may prove functional coverage but cannot prove multi-source convergence.

limitations: The current bonded-pair manufacturing strategy is intentionally narrow.
Functional coverage is not equivalent to full assembly correctness when multiple reagent streams must converge.
Placed geometry, timing and collision validity remain downstream solver responsibilities.
